product_one_liner.value: DataGrail is an AI-powered privacy-management platform for business privacy teams that automates data discovery and mapping, data-subject requests, consent management, and privacy risk assessments.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found in the navigation or footer; the site directs buyers to demo/contact options, and /pricing/ did not expose a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the homepage customer logo wall and are explicitly named among brands DataGrail serves.

employee_band.notes: The available LinkedIn company record reports 73 employees.

eng_blog.notes: An engineering category exists, but only one qualifying technical post was found: API Design Series – Part 1. Other reviewed posts concern culture, general security, or product strategy rather than implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes multiple articles covering Request Manager, Consent, Live Data Map, Risk Assessments, and data discovery.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists customer success, IT/business systems, and demand-generation roles; none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Claude Sonnet 5, hosted on AWS Bedrock
model_provider.notes: Vera's security documentation explicitly names the model and hosting environment.

compliance_certs.notes: DataGrail claims SOC 2 Type II certification and HIPAA compliance; HIPAA is described as compliance, not certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding-history profile, updated October 31, 2026, lists this as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round was October 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive application page remains live with an Apply option, although it was absent from the main job index.

launched_6mo.notes: July 2026 introduced Vera-powered email intake, replacing rule-based parsing with AI that identifies requesters, classifies requests, and enables automated privacy-request workflows.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Christopher Wright's profile lists his DataGrail role as VP of GTM Ops, Growth & AI starting in June 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The demand-generation posting describes existing HubSpot infrastructure, a Salesforce sync, and paid campaigns managed through Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
